name: Kaede Iku
source:
Iku is president of the magic club at a high school in Toshima. She's very strong-willed and makes impertinent remarks without thinking twice. She's also a total ninja maniac.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
